# Sources

arXiv / RSS / inbox adapters: fetch candidates, acquire (download/archive), and extract text.

**Tier:** Core

## Public API

### `influx.extraction.article`
- class `ArticleExtractionResult` — Result of a successful web article extraction.
- def `extract_article_from_html` — Extract article text from an already-fetched HTML body.
- def `extract_article` — Fetch *url* and extract article text from the HTML body.

### `influx.extraction.html`
- class `ExtractionResult` — Result of a successful HTML extraction.
- def `extract_html` — Fetch *url* and extract article text from the HTML body.

### `influx.extraction.pdf`
- class `PdfExtractionResult` — Result of a successful PDF extraction.
- def `extract_pdf` — Extract plain text from *pdf_bytes*.

### `influx.extraction.pipeline`
- class `ArxivExtractionResult` — Successful arXiv extraction outcome.
- def `extract_arxiv_text` — Run the HTML → PDF extraction cascade for an arXiv paper.

### `influx.sources`
- class `FetchCache` — Per-fire fetch deduplication cache (R-8).
- def `make_item_provider` — Build a unified item provider for arXiv + RSS with fetch dedup.

### `influx.sources.arxiv`
- class `ArxivItem` — A single parsed arXiv entry from the Atom feed.
- class `BackfillRange` — Resolved backfill date range with absolute UTC bounds.
- def `resolve_backfill_range` — Convert a ``run_range`` dict into a concrete :class:`BackfillRange`.
- def `build_query_url` — Build the arXiv API query URL per FR-SRC-1.
- class `ArxivCooldownError` — Raised by ``_fetch_with_retry`` when cooldown suppresses a fetch.
- def `fetch_arxiv` — Fetch and filter arXiv items for the given config.
- def `build_arxiv_note_item` — Build a complete ``ProfileItem`` dict for the scheduler.
- class `ArxivSource` — arXiv adapter conforming to :class:`influx.source.Source`.
- def `make_arxiv_item_provider` — Build the production-default ``item_provider`` for arXiv profiles.

### `influx.sources.inbox`
- class `InboxAcquisition` — One inbox URL acquired once: archive state + extracted body.
- def `acquire_inbox_bytes` — Download + extract one inbox URL into the fixed inbox archive subtree.
- def `acquire_inbox_pdf` — Acquire one local PDF into the fixed ``inbox-pdf`` archive subtree.
- def `build_inbox_note_item` — Build a complete ``ProfileItem`` for one (item, profile) ingestion.

### `influx.sources.note_builder`
- def `append_cascade_outcome_tags` — Append the cascade-driven outcome tags every builder emits.
- def `render_note_content` — Render the canonical note, applying the shared Tier-1 summary rule.
- def `profile_item_dict` — Assemble the 14-key ``ProfileItem`` dict the scheduler consumes.

### `influx.sources.rss`
- class `RssFeedItem` — A single parsed item from an RSS/Atom feed.
- def `parse_feed` — Parse RSS/Atom feed content and return per-item records.
- def `build_rss_note_item` — Build a complete ``ProfileItem`` dict for an RSS feed item.
- class `RssSource` — RSS adapter conforming to :class:`influx.source.Source`.
- def `make_rss_item_provider` — Build the item provider for RSS feed profiles.
